**[BLOCKING]** `orders/config.py` and `orders/money.py`: with this change, delivery is free for every order in any zone that has no free-delivery offer.

The default changed from `None` ("no offer in this zone") to `0`. `delivery_fee` in `orders/money.py` still guards with `zone.free_over_pence is not None and subtotal_pence >= zone.free_over_pence`. With the default at 0, the `is not None` check is always true. Any subtotal is `>= 0`, so the function returns 0 and never charges the fee.

The CB4 zone in `ZONES` omits `free_over_pence`, so `load_zones` gives it 0. Every CB4 order, for example a £5 subtotal, now gets a delivery fee of 0 instead of 349p, or 499p during surge. No error is raised, and the only symptom is lost delivery revenue.

Either keep `None` as the "no offer" sentinel, or make 0 mean "no offer". For the second option, change the check to `zone.free_over_pence > 0 and subtotal_pence >= zone.free_over_pence`. The mypy complaint and the config service sending ints are separate issues. If the service sends an explicit 0 or null for "no offer", handle that when loading.
